title: Remove ULA address init from IPv6 init path
description: Remove lichen_make_ula() call and ULA net_if_ipv6_addr_add from IPv6 init in lichen/subsys/lichen/ipv6/. Nodes should only have fe80:: link-local + 02xx:: Yggdrasil global. ~15 lines across 1-2 files. Depends on child 1 (Kconfig removal).
